verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a developer video platform, which could ship an AI assistant or agent interface. The evidence shows only SDKs, server APIs, webhooks, and a low-code offering. An llms.txt docs file serves LLM readers of the documentation; it is not a way to operate the product with natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
